player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} mu Connect Four.
Ishikoti lyako: {symbol}.
Bodi ya michezo ina {num_rows} safu na {num_cols} safu wima.
Wachezaji walondolola zamu zao kwa kuweka ishikoti lawo mu safu wima (0 hadi {end_col}).
Wakwanza kubatanisha (ishikoti zao) nne wima, mlalo, au diagonal wina.
Pa zamu yako, ingiza nambari ya safu wima mu mabano ya mraba ili uweke uamuzi wako.
Kwa mfano: '[col 4]' au '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Abangala te kuti bamone icipao ca kucimfyanya.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mwina {player_id}, Fomu ya kuchita si sahihi. Fomu inayotarajiwa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mwina {player_id}, Kuchita kosa. Koloni {col} ili pamoza na mipaka.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} alidondosha ishikoti lake ({player_symbol}) mu safu wima {col}.

outcome.draw: Ukuteya kwapwile fye pa kuti bonse bapwe.
